data.content:
I drafted and sent two of the three disputes, both with your approval. I held back the third because its evidence is weak.

| Case | Amount | Evidence | Win chance | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UE-9a31 | $24.30 | Moderate. The ticket lists the Honey Drizzle. The order was ready at 12:28 and picked up at 12:33. | 65% | Sent |
| UE-9a47 | $11.80 | Strong. The ticket lists only a Protein Bowl, not the claimed Fruit Bowl. The order was ready at 18:20 and picked up at 18:22. | 85% | Sent |
| UE-9b02 | $33.00 | Weak. There is no order ticket on file, so the claimed Green Smoothie can't be checked. | 30% | Not drafted |

- **Limits of the evidence:** A ticket shows what was prepared, not what was packed, so the disputes make no claim about what was in the bag. They state only the ticket and handoff facts.
- **UE-9b02:** This is the largest deduction, but it dropped from 55% to 30% once the evidence came back. **Please send me a photo of the ticket for order UE-9b02.** With it I can re-check the case and draft a dispute if the ticket supports it.
- **Lessons from past disputes:** My memory has no Uber Eats history, and the recall results for these cases were empty. The lessons I have are all from DoorDash, so I didn't apply any of them.
- **Next deadline:** 2026-12-12, which is 28 days away. It applies to all three cases, including UE-9b02.

I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`. When the platform decides these, tell me the results and I'll record them so future triage can learn from them.
